analyticsDisabledWarning: We strongly recommend keeping this enabled so we can find and fix issues faster.
apiAgentsDescription: Run transcription from scripts, CLI tools, or AI agents using Vibe's local API.
askForDownloadModel: Would you like to download the model from the website
askForInstallYtdlpMessage: Do you want to install yt-dlp which is used for downloading audio from popular websites?
askForRelaunchBody: Do you want to relaunch now?
askForUpdateBody: Do you want to update vibe into version {version}?
askForUpdateYtdlpMessage: New yt-dlp version found. Do you want to update yt-dlp?
unloadModelAfterInactivityInfo: Releases model memory and VRAM after there has been no transcription activity. The next transcription may take longer while the model reloads.
zeroMeansNever: Set to 0 to keep the model loaded.
confirmExit: Do you want to exit? Unsaved changes will be lost.
agentPromptHint: Ask Codex or Claude: “Summarize my last Vibe meeting.”
crashedRecently: Since the app is crashed recently, the GPU is disabled. you can enable it in the settings.
customizeInfo: Download any supported model in ggml or gguf format (with the file extension ending in '.bin'). Transfer it to the models directory, then select from the dropdown. No need to restart 🌟
downloadDiarizeModel: Speaker diarization requires a model (~25MB). Download it now?
exportDialogDescription: Choose what to export and how you'd like to use it.
globalDictationPromo: Press a shortcut anywhere to instantly transcribe. Works while Vibe runs in the background.
globalHotkeyDescription: Hold the shortcut to record, release to transcribe.
hotkeyActivationPushToTalkDescription: Hold the shortcut to record, then release it to transcribe.
hotkeyActivationToggleDescription: Press once to start recording, then press again to stop and transcribe.
dictationIndicatorSettingInfo: Shows a small floating Vibe indicator while global dictation is listening and transcribing.
normalizeHotkeyOutputInfo: Collapses line breaks and extra spaces into single spaces, so the result is one clean line of text instead of multiple lines.
infoCancelDownload: You can cancel and download the model manually later.
infoDiarizeThreshold: Threshold for speaker recognition or consider as not detected
infoDiarization: Detect and label different speakers in the audio. Requires downloading a separate model.
infoEnableLogs: Write logs to file. Please restart after enabling it.
infoGpuDevice: Select the GPU device for transcription. Enter the GPU device number, starting from 0. If you have 2 GPUs, choose either 0 or 1.
infoHighGpuPerformance: Enhances graphics performance for Vibe, but will consume more system resources.
infoLlmApiKey: The API key from the website of the AI model
infoLlmPrompt: Prompt for the AI model. Must include the pattern %s which will be replaced with the transcription.
infoLlmSummarize: Summarize with AI. Requires API key. Once the transcription is complete, it will be sent to Claude API along with the chosen prompt and then in a few seconds, the answer from the AI will be displayed in Vibe instead of the transcription. Works also when transcribing multiple files!
infoManualDownload: Internet connection is required to download the AI model
infoMaxSentenceLen: How many letters will be in a single sentence. Works only when word timestamps are on.
infoMaxSpeakers: How many speakers should be in the file. Used for more precise recognition
infoMaxTextCtx: Max context tokens to use from the past text as prompt for the decoder
infoContextSize: Maximum transcript context sent to the AI model.
infoNormalizeLoudness: Enable this option for better transcription accuracy. It may take up to 8 minutes per hour of audio.
infoPrompt: Make transcripts better by writing expected words.
infoRecognizeSpeakers: Detect speaker in each sentence and add it
infoTemperature: Higher values lead to more unique words; lower values stick to common ones. Usually set around 0.4 for a balanced result.
infoThreads: Increase CPU for faster decoding; balance speed with resource usage. Recommended: 4
infoTranslateToEnglish: Translate transcription into English from any language by enabling this option
infoUseWordTimestamps: Transcript with word timestamps instead of sentence timestamps. Useful in JSON format. Disabled when speaker recognition is on.
invalidLlmPrompt: Invalid prompt. It must include the following pattern %s which will be replaced with the transcription.
contextSizeRuleOfThumb: Rule of thumb: 64K tokens fits about 5 hours of speech; language and pace vary.
modelFileCorrupt: This model file is incomplete or corrupt
modelFileCorruptDescription: {name} failed its integrity check. Re-download it to replace the broken file.
pleaseEnableWordTimestamps:
Please enable word timestamps to use this option!
Also make sure to disable this option once you finished or reset the model options!
pleaseSetMaxSentenceLen:
Word timestamps also need a max sentence length — on its own this option changes nothing.
Set it to 1 for a timestamp per word, or higher to group words into lines.
promptMustContainPlaceholder: Prompt must contain %s as a placeholder for the transcript
resetAskDialog: Are you sure you want to reset Vibe? App data will be cleared including models files.
meetingDetectionInfo: Notify me when Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams starts using the microphone so I can choose whether to record.
autoTranscribeAfterRecordingInfo: Start transcription automatically after a recording finishes.
recordingReadyInfo: Your audio is saved. Choose a language and options when you’re ready to transcribe.
recordingSettingsInfo: Configure recording permissions and a global shortcut for starting and stopping recordings.
recordingShortcutEnabledInfo: Start or stop a recording from anywhere. Finished recordings are saved as projects.
recordingShortcutInfo: Press once to start recording and again to stop.
systemAudioPermissionInfo: Required to record audio playing on your Mac.
recordingShortcutRegistrationFailed: Could not register the recording shortcut
recordingAlreadyInProgress: Another recording is already in progress.
projectsFolderInfo: Vibe stores each transcript and its media together in this folder.
autoSummarizeOnFinishInfo: Create a summary when a new transcription finishes. Existing projects are never summarized automatically.
gpuFallbackToCpu: GPU failed to load model. Falling back to CPU.
avx2NotSupported: Your CPU is not supported by this version of Vibe. Please use a more modern PC.
transcribeEngineStoppedBatchStopped: The transcription engine stopped. Stopping batch.
noModelSelected: Select a model in Settings to get started
downloadDefaultModelDescription: Download the default model to start transcribing.
transcriptWillDisplayedShortly: Transcript will be displayed here shortly...
ytdlpOptionsInfo: Vibe uses yt-dlp for URL transcription.
ytdlpUpdateAvailable: A new yt-dlp version is available
ytdlpUpdateAvailableInfo: Version {version} is out. Updating usually fixes links that stopped working.
ytdlpUpdateAfterFailure: The download failed. Updating yt-dlp to {version} usually fixes links that stopped working.
stableTimestampsInfo: Uses VAD per-segment decode for tighter subtitle timing. Around 4x slower; best for movie/long-form transcript work.
stableTimestampsSlowNote: Highly accurate timestamps, but around 4x slower.
translateWhisperModelNote: Whisper medium/large only; not v3 Turbo.
samplingStrategyInfo: Greedy vs Beam Search: Default is Beam Search (Size 5, Patience -1), which evaluates 5 possible sequences at each step for more accurate results, but is slower. Greedy, on the other hand, selects the best token from the top 5 at each step, making it faster but potentially less accurate.
greedyInfo: Top candidates in Greedy mode (default: 5) — higher = better accuracy, slower.
beamInfo: Paths explored in Beam Search (default: 5) — higher = better accuracy, slower.
stableTimestampsConfirm: Stable timestamps requires a VAD model (~1MB). Download it now?
agentInstructionsCopied: Agent skill instructions copied to clipboard
localApiUnreachable: Could not reach the local API
permissionAudioRecording: Please enable system audio recording in System Settings, then try again.
deleteTranscriptBody: Delete “{name}”? The transcript and its copy of the audio will be removed.
savedProjectsInfo: Every transcription Vibe saved, with its copy of the audio.
deleteAllProjectsInfo: Removes {count} saved project(s) from the projects folder.
deleteAllProjectsBody: Delete all {count} saved project(s)? Their transcripts and copies of the audio will be removed. This cannot be undone.
dropFilesHere: Drop audio, video or a folder here
orClickToBrowse: or click to browse your files
dropToAddToQueue: Drop to add to the queue
pasteMediaLink: Paste a video or audio link
couldNotOpenFolder: Could not open the containing folder
audioCopyUnavailable: Saving a copy of the audio is not available here
saveProjectsInfo: Automatically save transcripts and media in the projects folder.
promptPlaceholder: Names, jargon or spellings you expect in the audio — for example: Vibe, Tauri, Whisper
fakeUpdateAvailableInfo: Shows the update dot and button as if a new version were waiting.
llmPromptPlaceholder: Summarize the following transcript in clear bullet points:%s
closeToTrayInfo: Closing the window leaves Vibe running in the tray, so global dictation keeps working. Quit it from the tray menu.
launchAtStartupInfo: Open Vibe automatically when you log in to your computer.
couldNotEnableLaunchAtStartup: Could not enable launch at startup: {error}
couldNotDisableLaunchAtStartup: Could not disable launch at startup: {error}
preventSleepInfo: Stops the idle timer from putting the computer to sleep while Vibe runs, so it stays reachable — your phone can hand off a recording to it at any time. The screen still turns off. Uses more battery.
phoneHandoffInfo: Record on your phone and let this computer do the transcribing — the transcript comes straight back to the phone.
phoneHandoffToggleInfo: Pair a phone once, then record from it any time.
phoneHandoffRelayNote: Audio travels through a relay server because phone browsers cannot connect directly, but it is end-to-end encrypted — the relay only sees ciphertext. Vibe has to stay open on this computer for the phone to reach it.
phoneHandoffUnavailable: Phone handoff is not available in this build of Vibe.
pairingQrCodeError: Could not render the pairing code.
scanPairingCodeInfo: Point your phone’s camera at this code, then keep the page it opens.
endpointIdInfo: Endpoint id your phone connects to
phoneWaitingForRecording: Waiting for a phone to send a recording.
phoneTranscriptSentBack: Done — the transcript went back to your phone.
regeneratePairingCodeInfo: Issues a new code and invalidates the old one — a phone that is already paired has to scan again.
skillSectionDescription: Install the same instructions as a skill, so every agent session has them without pasting.
